clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says look at what shows up when they actually test tap water across the country.

Fluoride. He says it wipes out your thyroid, slows your metabolism, and can leave you gaining weight and feeling low.

Cholesterol-lowering drugs. Birth control hormones. Measured in the same water millions of people drink every single day.

Nobody asked you if you wanted any of that in your glass.

Filter what you drink, and start reading past the headline on what's really in your water.

#kevintrudeau #tapwater #fluoride #cleanwater #readthelabel #wbdaily

Kevin Trudeau says the government just admitted something it spent years denying.

The headline: first-ever national drinking water limits on toxic PFASs, the so-called forever chemicals.

In plain English, Kevin says: they're admitting these chemicals are toxic to your health, and still choosing to allow a certain amount in the water supply instead of removing them.

His read on why: the sicker people get, the more medication gets sold.

You can't control what's already in the pipes. You can control what you filter before it reaches your glass.

#kevintrudeau #pfas #foreverchemicals #cleanwater #toxins #wbdaily

Kevin Trudeau tells a story about being a kid who did dumb things: eating dirt, chewing on a styrofoam cup.

His mother yelled every single time, hard enough that one day he cried and told her, "You just like being mean."

She said it would be a lot easier on her if she didn't care.

Years later, a friend's mother never once raised her voice. That friend cried too, for the opposite reason: "My mother doesn't care about me."

The lesson Kevin took from it: the parent correcting you is the one paying attention.

#kevintrudeau #selfimage #mindset #parenting #confidence #wbdaily
